description: HTTP contract of Workshop sessions, artifacts, approval and edits under /api (Learning context path). Authority: docs/architecture/ai-generation-platform.md sections 3-5 and 7. Implemented so far: AI-04 (#287: sessions, events, artifact) and AI-05 (#288: approval, rejection, hand-off, retry, delete, note archival). AI-13 (#291) adds EXERCISES sessions and the exercise side of approval, re-pin and retry; AI-11 (#293) and AI-06 (#289) implement or consume the rest. AI-16 (#294) adds the intent of «Попросить Мнему…» (createIntent), REVISE_ITEM and REVISE_EXERCISE sessions and the exercise edits.

conventions.owner: The JWT subject is the only owner input. Foreign or absent deck, session or artifact IDs share one opaque 404.
conventions.caching: Every response is Cache-Control: private, no-store.
conventions.ids: Canonical lowercase UUID strings. commandId is UUIDv4 or UUIDv7; entity IDs are any registered version.
conventions.versions: rowVersion, deckVersion and event cursors are decimal strings. ETag is the quoted rowVersion; If-Match is exactly one quoted canonical decimal (no weak validator, wildcard, list or leading zeros).
conventions.preconditions: Missing required precondition 428 PRECONDITION_REQUIRED, malformed 400 INVALID_REQUEST, stale 412 VERSION_CONFLICT. Approval pins the Deck version in If-Match and the artifact version, revision and Deck revision in the body. Cancel and delete need no If-Match: they are state-idempotent. A session's rowVersion bumps on every row change and is exposed as ETag for reads; the one session command that takes it is approvePlan, in the body as expectedSessionVersion.
conventions.evaluationOrder: 1 authentication and ownership (foreign or unknown IDs, including an unknown or foreign note ID in sources, are 404: no existence oracle); 2 command receipt replay (same commandId and body returns the stored response with Idempotency-Replayed: true, before anything else is re-evaluated); 3 request validation (400); 4 preconditions (428, then 412 on If-Match and expected versions); 5 state (409 GENERATION_STATE_CONFLICT, EDIT_IN_PROGRESS, SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE, 422 limits); 6 usage (409 USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED, last, inside the admission transaction). Nothing changes state before step 6 passes.
conventions.problemExtensions: Problem extension members (capability, reason, bucket, limits ...) are added by the run-2 tasks through a small typed ProblemExtension map in platform.api; AI-01 (#281) is the first user. ApiErrorCode itself keeps its fixed status, title and detail.
conventions.idempotency: Every POST command carries commandId. An exact retry returns the stored original status and body with Idempotency-Replayed: true and no ETag; changed reuse is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Replays are not current reads: reconcile with GET.
conventions.errors: RFC 9457 application/problem+json with type urn:mnema:problem:<kebab-code>, title, status, detail, instance, code and the extension members listed in errors.json. Detail never echoes content.
conventions.bodyLimit: Request bodies are strict JSON (exact field sets, duplicate keys rejected) of at most 64 KiB; none of them carries a document.

notes: Owned by AI-01 (#281): the endpoint, the rate-card math and the reservation. The generation module supplies the spec interpretation and the personal-data scan hooks as they land (AI-04 and later).
Not keyed by commandId: it is a pure function of the spec, the rate card and the current balance.

REVISE_ITEM and REVISE_EXERCISE (AI-16, #294) are priced as one edit turn (EDIT_SELECTION) when there is an instruction, plus one text-to-speech clip (TTS_CLIP_30S) when the spec has a media action; the target is checked as for createSession (404 unknown or foreign, 409 not the head, 409 capability).

With settings.planFirst the breakdown has its own line SMART_PLAN_FLASH (1 unit, 20 credits on rc-v1) before the batch lines, so the cost of the plan is shown apart from the cost of what it would generate; a budgetPercent caps the batch, the plan comes on top; a full smart-plan count cap is a blockingBuckets entry (SMART_PLAN).

endpoints.summary: «Попросить Мнему…»: one sentence of the owner, with the material or the exercise they are looking at, becomes a spec, editable chips and notes. Free: nothing is reserved or debited, no session is created.

fields.context: {kind: MATERIAL, memberKey} (a current member of the deck) or {kind: EXERCISE, exerciseId} (an exercise on the deck's roster); exact fields

errors.when: Malformed or unknown field, duplicate JSON key, bad UUID, an unknown context kind, a text that is blank or longer than 2000 code points.
Foreign or absent deck, a material that is not a current member of the deck, an exercise that is not on its roster: one opaque boundary.
aiGeneration is off, or the provider cannot answer now (reason TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE or PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED).
More than learning.generation.intent.per-hour (30) calls by the account in a rolling hour.
errors.retryAfter: whole seconds, also the Retry-After header

notes: Free and stateless: no reservation, no debit, no commandId, no receipt (a retry is another call and another place of the hour). The model call is journaled (ai_provider_call, with its cost) like any other. The credits are taken by the session that the owner starts afterwards from the spec, which is the only step that reserves (architecture section 13).

Order: 404 deck, 400 body, 404 context, 409 capability, 429, the call. One call on the fast text route, strict JSON, temperature 0.2; an answer outside the closed vocabulary is sent back once, then (and for a refusal) the answer is UNSUPPORTED; a provider that is down is 409 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE.

The model chooses only operation (EXERCISES | REVISE_ITEM | REVISE_EXERCISE | UNSUPPORTED), mechanics (AUTO or registry names), a number (perTarget), a sentence (instruction, at most 2000 code points) and a voice (female | male). The SERVER builds the spec: the target is the request's context pinned at its head (never the model's); mechanics are filtered by the registry; perTarget is clamped to 1..learning.generation.max-exercises-per-target (10) with a note PER_TARGET_CLAMPED («Не больше 10 на материал»); budgetPercent is never set; every member the vocabulary does not have is dropped. So no sentence can produce a spec above the limits.

Context matrix: MATERIAL allows EXERCISES and REVISE_ITEM; EXERCISE allows EXERCISES (for the material the exercise is about) and REVISE_EXERCISE. Any other operation, a voice change for an exercise without audio (NO_AUDIO), whose audio has no transcript to synthesise (NO_TRANSCRIPT, AI-09: a redo speaks the transcript) or when the redo cannot run (MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE), and an instruction the model did not give (NO_INSTRUCTION) are UNSUPPORTED with spec null, chips [] and a note in words.

spec is exactly what createSession and estimateGeneration accept (post it with a commandId); chips are its editable parameters ({kind: OPERATION | MECHANICS | PER_TARGET | INSTRUCTION | VOICE, value, ...}); notes are [{code, text, limit?}] with texts built by the server, never the model's own words.

endpoints.summary: Create a session and its artifacts, reserve the initial batch, enqueue steps; all in one transaction.

errors.when: Malformed or unknown field, duplicate JSON key, bad UUID or version. A REVISE_ITEM or REVISE_EXERCISE spec of the wrong shape, or whose target cannot be revised, named by the additive `reason` member: TARGET_UNSUPPORTED_BLOCK, TARGET_PERSONAL_DATA, TARGET_MEDIA_ONLY or TARGET_NO_AUDIO.
errors.reason: TARGET_UNSUPPORTED_BLOCK | TARGET_PERSONAL_DATA | TARGET_MEDIA_ONLY | TARGET_NO_AUDIO (REVISE_* only; absent for the other 400s)

errors.when: Foreign or absent deck, session or artifact: one opaque boundary.

The reservation or debit does not fit a credit, cap, fair-use or daily-burst limit. With settings.planFirst the plan's own hold and the smart-plan count cap (bucket SMART_PLAN; offered false on a plan without smart plans) are checked too, together with the batch hold. The owner's plans that are still being made (PLANNING sessions) count against the smart-plan cap as if consumed, so a plan the cap cannot cover is refused before it is made.
A capability the operation needs is off.

A pinned owned note or material exists but no longer matches the pin (an EXERCISES target that is no longer the material's head), or has been deleted since. A REVISE_ITEM target that is not the head of its material, a REVISE_EXERCISE target that is not the head of its exercise (sources type EXERCISE), an exercise whose material is gone or cannot be followed.
commandId was used for a different command.
settings.planFirst true (MATERIALS or EXERCISES) while the planner is disabled (learning.generation.planner.enabled=false; it is on by default since AI-14, #295).
More than 3 active sessions (PLANNING, PLAN_READY, RUNNING, and REVIEW with a PROPOSED, REVISING or STALE artifact; the problem lists activeSessionIds), too many artifacts, targets or exercises.
errors.limit: ACTIVE_SESSIONS | ARTIFACTS_PER_SESSION | EXERCISE_TARGETS | EXERCISES_PER_TARGET | EXERCISES_PER_SESSION | EDIT_TARGET_SIZE (REVISE_ITEM: the whole material is too long to rewrite in one turn)

notes: Exact retry returns the stored 201 with Idempotency-Replayed: true and no ETag; reconcile with getSession.

Initial state is RUNNING, or PLANNING when spec.settings.planFirst (decision 17): no artifact exists yet, two holds are taken (the batch hold exactly as it would be without the plan, so a plan that fits it always fits the reservation, and the plan's own price, SMART_PLAN_FLASH, held by the PLAN step and debited apart when the plan is ready) and one PLAN step is enqueued. The notes and materials of the spec are pinned as usual.
The session reservation covers the initial batch only (contracts/usage reservation lifecycle).
A pinned NOTE or ITEM that is unknown or foreign is 404; SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE is only for an owned source whose version no longer matches the pin.

EXERCISES (AI-13, decision 14 of the README): the targets are pinned as SOURCE items; the resolved quantity is spread over the targets in processing order (UNCOVERED_FIRST: fewest enabled exercises first; BALANCED: request order); one QUEUED artifact exists per exercise (targetKind EXERCISE, ordinal in processing order, then index) and one TEXT_DRAFT step per target fills them. A target that is not the material's head is 409 SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.

REVISE_ITEM (AI-16, decision 16): one artifact (target ITEM, sourceRefs the target) whose INITIAL revision is the head document copied without a model call, and one turn FREE over every top-level block with the spec's instruction (one EDIT step). The target must be the material's head (409 SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE otherwise). The session has no batch reservation: its holds are the turns' own (EDIT_SELECTION, 4 credits on rc-v1), taken here. The artifact is REVISING at creation and PROPOSED when the turn ends; the session is RUNNING meanwhile and REVIEW afterwards. No GENERATION_* notification is published for a revise session.

REVISE_EXERCISE (AI-16, decision 16): one artifact (target EXERCISE, sourceRefs [the material pin, the exercise pin]) whose INITIAL revision is the exercise's command copied without a model call ({objective: reuse the current one, exercise}), with a READY slot for each of its AUDIO blocks on the asset it already uses. instruction (when not blank) is one EDIT turn FREE that rewrites the exercise through the exercise pipeline; media {action: AUDIO_REGENERATE, voice} is one turn that redoes the audio on the Stub speech executor (until real synthesis, AI-09 #297: the audio does not change, the slot records the voice and keeps its asset) and starts after the rewrite is APPLIED. Each turn takes its own hold at creation (EDIT_SELECTION 4 credits; TTS_CLIP_30S 10 credits, released unspent by the Stub).

AI-18 (#299): with settings.factCheck on an effort above short, each material gets a RESEARCH step before its TEXT_DRAFT (TEXT_DRAFT waits for it): a cheap model call proposes at most the effort's request cap (Средний 2, Подробный 6, Авто 3; learning.ai.research.max-requests caps all at 15) queries, the server runs them through WebSearch, dedupes by normalized URL and numbers the results; TEXT_DRAFT gets them as untrusted <search_result> blocks and an allowlist, writes [n] and ::sources, and the compiler keeps only allowlisted URLs as links (any other link stays text). A research failure does not fail the material: TEXT_DRAFT runs with any sources already found or without sources; research.requests is 0 only when no billed request occurred. The hold is WEB_SEARCH_QUERY × cap; the debit is per request actually made, including a paid answer rejected by the parser, and fallback never exceeds the cap. Research respects the daily debit burst and parks before provider calls until the next Moscow day when it cannot fit. Needs the webSearch capability at admission (409 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE otherwise).

The plan as approved costs more than the batch hold and the balance cannot pay the difference. The hold is re-sized to the plan inside this transaction (the old one is released first, so what it held counts); a refusal changes nothing.

notes: Decision 17. Evaluation: ownership (404), receipt replay, shape and identifiers (400), expectedSessionVersion (412), state (409 ILLEGAL_STATE), capabilities (409 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE), limits (422), usage (409, last).

In one transaction: the artifacts and steps of exactly the planned items are created through the same code as an unplanned admission (EXERCISES: one QUEUED artifact per exercise in plan order and one TEXT_DRAFT step per target, carrying the mechanics the plan chose for that target; MATERIALS: one artifact per item, written at the item's effort on the item's title), the batch hold is released and a new one of exactly the cost of the plan is made, the plan is stored as approved and the session is RUNNING (SESSION_STATE, one ARTIFACT_STATE per artifact, USAGE_UPDATED). The events are in the order of an unplanned admission: SESSION_STATE (RUNNING, with the counts of the artifacts just created), one ARTIFACT_STATE per artifact, USAGE_UPDATED.

The plan's own cost was debited when the plan became ready (SMART_PLAN_FLASH, apart from the batch) and stays debited whatever happens next, also when the session is cancelled or deleted in PLAN_READY; the batch hold of a PLAN_READY session is not renewed and lapses after learning.usage.reservation-ttl, so an approval later than that reserves again and may be refused as USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED.
Exact retry returns the stored 200 with Idempotency-Replayed: true and no ETag; reconcile with getSession. A cost above the hold extends it: the owner saw the cost of the plan before launching it.

endpoints.summary: Archive the notes the session used: exactly the NOTE sources of its PUBLISHED or HANDED_OFF artifacts, each by its pinned row_version. Explicit and idempotent.

errors.when: Malformed or unknown field, duplicate JSON key, bad UUID or version.
Foreign or absent deck, session or artifact: one opaque boundary.
commandId was used for a different command.

notes: No If-Match. Allowed in every session state (CLOSED, CANCELLED and EXPIRED included) until the retention worker purges the session, then 404.

"Used" means at least one PUBLISHED or HANDED_OFF artifact pins the note AND no artifact of the session still in play (QUEUED, GENERATING, PROPOSED, REVISING, STALE or a retryable FAILED) pins it: archiving bumps the note's row_version, which would turn such a sibling STALE. Notes still in use are simply not part of the command (no skip reason). Each used note is archived through the capture archive command with the pinned noteRowVersion as the expected version. A note whose current row_version differs is skipped CHANGED (never archived silently); an archived note is skipped ALREADY_ARCHIVED (checked first); a deleted one DELETED. No used notes is a 200 with empty lists.
Exact retry returns the stored response with Idempotency-Replayed: true and no ETag. A second call with a new commandId is harmless: everything archived is ALREADY_ARCHIVED.
The session is not changed: no event, no version bump. The count the UI needs is sessionDetail.notes.

endpoints.summary: Current revision (or an exact one), media slots, revision list and turns. NOTE entries of sourceRefs carry a read-time, informational status (decision 13): CURRENT (the note is at the pinned row_version), CHANGED (its row_version moved and it is not only archived), ARCHIVED (it moved, is archived and its text is still the pinned text) or DELETED. It never changes the artifact: staleness stays decision 4.

query.revisionId: optional: read this revision's payload; the current pointer is unchanged

errors.when: Malformed or unknown field, duplicate JSON key, bad UUID or version.
Foreign or absent deck, session or artifact: one opaque boundary.

notes: ITEM payload is a native-v1 document; EXERCISE payload is the objective and exercise members of the exercise publication command (contracts/study); commandId and expectedDeckRevisionId are supplied at approval.

turns lists the turns of the current generation of the draft, oldest first, in the turn shape (REMOVE_MEDIA turns included; a retry starts a new draft, so earlier instructions are not listed); revisions lists the revisions of that generation {revisionId, cause INITIAL | EDIT | MEDIA | REPIN, createdAt}, oldest first, which are the ones a revert may restore; ?revisionId= returns any revision's payload, older generations included (an unknown one is 404) while currentRevisionId stays the pointer, so a client builds the diff of an edit from the previous and the result revision. mediaSlots are the slots of the media nodes the shown revision holds, whichever revision each slot is attached to now.

An EXERCISE detail adds the read-only display {mechanic, objectiveTitle, quotes}: the mechanic, the title of the objective the exercise evidences (the offered or the new one) and the plain text of every MATERIAL node the exercise quotes, by node id, as it reads in the pinned revision (so a client renders MATERIAL blocks without further requests). It is absent for ITEM artifacts and when revision is null. The artifact title is the first TEXT block of the prompt, else the objective title.
Model route, prompt version and provenance are never returned.
Read-only: never changes state.

AI-18 (#299): an ITEM artifact made with «Проверять факты» (spec settings.factCheck on an effort above short) carries `research`: {requests: number of paid search requests made, results: [{n, url, title, provider (YANDEX | PERPLEXITY | STUB)}] in [n] order} — the URLs the compiler allowed for `[n]` links and `::sources`; null when the material had no research. Snippets and page text are never returned or stored beyond the session.

endpoints.summary: Publish one artifact into the catalog in one transaction (approve).

requestHeaders.If-Match: Quoted decimal Deck rowVersion (as in contracts/items); missing 428, malformed 400, stale 412.

errors.when: Malformed or unknown field, duplicate JSON key, bad UUID or version.
Foreign or absent deck, session or artifact: one opaque boundary.
Deck, artifact or revision version is stale; read again, then retry with a new commandId.
If-Match missing.
State is not PROPOSED, a media slot is neither READY nor REMOVED, or a pinned source changed (the artifact became STALE in a short transaction before the publish transaction).
commandId was used for a different command.

notes: Exact retry returns the stored acknowledgement with Idempotency-Replayed: true and no ETag.
Item approval publishes through the caller-owned port into ItemService; exercise approval through ExerciseService with objective.operation=reuse where the target objective is unchanged.

The catalog command carries a command id derived from commandId and artifactId (a name-based hash shaped as a version-4 UUID, because a version-5 value is not a legal command id), so a repeat is the same command. A session CLOSED, EXPIRED, PLANNING or PLAN_READY answers ILLEGAL_STATE; a rowVersion or revision mismatch is 412 before any state conflict.

A PROPOSED EXERCISE artifact whose target material has a newer head is re-pinned by the server before the publish transaction (no model call): if every block the model was shown is unchanged in the head, every MATERIAL node of the exercise still reads as text in the new revision and the exercise passes the checks that read the material text, the publication command and the probes again, a REPIN revision replaces the current one, repinStatus is AUTO_REPINNED and the approval goes on with it; otherwise the artifact becomes STALE (NEEDS_USER_DECISION) in a short transaction of its own and the answer is 409 SOURCE_STALE.

Exercise approval publishes through the caller-owned port GeneratedExercisePublisher into ExerciseService with a child command id derived from commandId and artifactId and marks the exercise «Новое» (contracts/study). A create objective whose normalized title equals the title of an objective already bound to the same subject material is published as a reuse of it, so approving three exercises of one direction creates one objective. A reuse objective whose head moved is published against the current head while it is still bound to the subject member; a gone or foreign-bound objective makes the artifact STALE (NEEDS_USER_DECISION, 409 SOURCE_STALE).

REVISE_ITEM / REVISE_EXERCISE (AI-16): approval is an ordinary revise with the same preconditions (If-Match deck version, expected artifact version, revision and deck revision). A material is saved as the next revision of the member it was made of, at its place, with the structural edits the revision needs (publishedRef {kind: ITEM, memberKey (the target's), itemRevisionId (the new one), ordinal}); an exercise as the next revision of the exercise in place, its objective the current one (publishedRef {kind: EXERCISE, exerciseId (the same), exerciseRevisionId (the new one), ...}) and it is not marked «Новое». The old revision stays in history. A head that moved since the copy makes the artifact STALE (409 GENERATION_STATE_CONFLICT, reason SOURCE_STALE) and is never re-pinned for a material or when the exercise itself moved; an exercise whose material only moved is re-pinned like any proposed exercise.

requestBodyOptional.replacement: EXERCISE artifacts only: {objective, exercise}, the exercise the owner edited in the exercise editor before saving (the shape of getArtifact payload.command). It is read by ExerciseCommand.readCreate only (a human edit is not linted), must keep the proposal's exercise.subject.memberKey and is published INSTEAD of the revision payload; provenance records edited: true. Not valid on an ITEM artifact or inside a bulk entry (INVALID_REQUEST). It is never auto re-pinned: it is published when it already stands on the head of its material (subject and quotes carry the head revision), otherwise the proposal becomes STALE (409 SOURCE_STALE, never 412).

Items only (AI-05): ONE bulk publication, one deck revision, with a command id derived from commandId and the sorted artifact ids; with exercises (AI-13) the materials go first as one bulk publication, then ExerciseService is called once per exercise with a child command id derived from commandId and the artifact id, each on the deck revision and version the previous publication left (chained). The response lists one acknowledgement per artifact (ITEM and EXERCISE shapes) and the final Deck revision.
The client lists exactly the artifacts it showed as approvable ('Approve all ready (N)'); an artifact that stopped being approvable fails the whole command.
A REVISE_ITEM or REVISE_EXERCISE session has one artifact and is approved with approveArtifact: a bulk approval of it is 400 INVALID_REQUEST.

notes: ITEM artifacts only; an EXERCISE hand-off is INVALID_REQUEST (the owner edits an exercise before saving it: approveArtifact with replacement).
The client then restores the draft with GET /api/editing-drafts/{draftId}.
The draft holds the revision's document without the media nodes whose assets are not READY (they cannot be saved); READY media stays.
A REVISE_ITEM artifact is handed off as an EditingDraft of the EXISTING material (member_key = the target, base_revision_id = the revision it was made of); an exercise (any session) is still 400.

endpoints.summary: Edit by selection, instruction or media redo. One edit per artifact at a time. A rewrite is accepted (202, turn QUEUED) and runs on the worker; REMOVE_MEDIA is applied before the answer.

fields.expectedRevisionId: the artifact's current revision as the client shows it (stale is 412 VERSION_CONFLICT)
fields.target: {nodeIds: 1..50 distinct node IDs of CONSECUTIVE top-level blocks of the current revision}; required for a material (absent or null is INVALID_REQUEST); absent or null for an EXERCISE (the whole exercise is edited), where a target is INVALID_REQUEST
fields.action: REWRITE | IMAGE_SEARCH | IMAGE_GENERATE | AUDIO_REGENERATE | FREE | REMOVE_MEDIA; an exercise of a REVISE_EXERCISE session accepts FREE and AUDIO_REGENERATE only
fields.preset: optional SIMPLER | SHORTER | EXAMPLE | LONGER; valid only with REWRITE (else INVALID_REQUEST); null is the same as absent
fields.instruction: text or speech transcript, 1..2000 code points, not blank; required for FREE, optional otherwise (ignored and stored as null for REMOVE_MEDIA); null is the same as absent
fields.voice: optional female | male: required for AUDIO_REGENERATE on an exercise (AI-16); optional for AUDIO_REGENERATE on a material audio node (AI-09: absent keeps the slot's voice); any other action with a voice is INVALID_REQUEST; null is the same as absent

errors.when: Malformed or unknown field, duplicate JSON key, bad UUID or version; a preset without REWRITE; FREE without an instruction; a media action on blocks of the wrong kind; or a target the edit cannot use, named by the additive `reason` member: TARGET_NOT_CONTIGUOUS (a nested node, an unknown or repeated ID, a gap), TARGET_UNSUPPORTED_BLOCK (a block MBM cannot express), TARGET_PERSONAL_DATA (a block whose text holds an e-mail address, a telephone or a card number) or TARGET_MEDIA_ONLY (a rewrite of media blocks only). For an exercise: a target, an action other than FREE and AUDIO_REGENERATE, a voice on FREE, AUDIO_REGENERATE without a voice, or TARGET_NO_AUDIO (the exercise has no audio block with a transcript to redo).
errors.reason: TARGET_NOT_CONTIGUOUS | TARGET_UNSUPPORTED_BLOCK | TARGET_PERSONAL_DATA | TARGET_MEDIA_ONLY | TARGET_NO_AUDIO (absent for the other 400s)

errors.when: Foreign or absent deck, session or artifact: one opaque boundary.
Another turn on this artifact is QUEUED or RUNNING.
The reservation or debit does not fit a credit, cap, fair-use or daily-burst limit.

A capability the operation needs is off: aiGeneration for REWRITE and FREE; imageSearch for IMAGE_SEARCH (AI-10); textToSpeech for AUDIO_REGENERATE of a material or an exercise (AI-09, #297: runnable when the flag is on and a speech adapter is configured, or with the Stub); imageGeneration for IMAGE_GENERATE, which stays refused (reason PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED when the gate itself passes) until image generation exists.
expectedRevisionId is not the current revision.

Operation not allowed in the current session or artifact state (states.json allowedOperations): the session is not RUNNING or REVIEW (a CANCELLED one accepts REMOVE_MEDIA only), the artifact is not PROPOSED, or the artifact is an EXERCISE of an EXERCISES session (only the exercise of a REVISE_EXERCISE session is edited).
commandId was used for a different command.
50 turns or 30 revisions already exist on the artifact (REMOVE_MEDIA is not counted as a turn and may use the revisions up to 40), or the blocks to rewrite are too big for the output bound.

notes: A block is the unit: a selection inside a paragraph widens to its block. nodeIds must be CONSECUTIVE top-level blocks of the current revision, in any request order, and include every block the selection touches, media blocks inside the run too (a skipped media block is a gap); anything else is INVALID_REQUEST with reason TARGET_NOT_CONTIGUOUS.

Evaluation order: 404, receipt replay, 400 body, 412 expectedRevisionId, 400 target (it can only be judged against the current revision), 409 state (session, artifact, EDIT_IN_PROGRESS, EXERCISE), 409 capability, 422 limits, 409 usage last. Nothing changes state before the usage step passes.

REWRITE and FREE (as EDIT_SELECTION, 4 credits on rc-v1) create their own turn-scoped reservation (scope TURN) at admission; insufficient means 409 USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED before any state change. The hold is debited when the turn is APPLIED and released unspent when it FAILS or is CANCELLED. «Ещё раз» is a new edit with a new commandId and takes its own hold. IMAGE_GENERATE (priced as in usage.json) is refused with 409 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE (decision 15). AUDIO_REGENERATE (AI-09) takes a TURN reservation of TTS_CLIP_30S, debited only when the synthesis missed the speech cache and released unspent on a cache hit or a failure. IMAGE_SEARCH (AI-10) takes a TURN reservation of IMAGE_SEARCH (1 credit on rc-v1), debited when the turn is APPLIED and released when it FAILS.

A rewrite is 202 with the turn QUEUED and the artifact REVISING; the worker runs one EDIT step (PT2M, at most three model calls: the answer, one repair, one on the strong route). The result is a new revision (cause EDIT), the turn APPLIED with resultRevisionId and the artifact PROPOSED on it; on failure the turn is FAILED with an errorCode, the artifact PROPOSED on the unchanged revision and nothing is debited. The client follows ARTIFACT_STATE and re-reads getArtifact (turns[], revisions[]).

REMOVE_MEDIA (extension to the architecture list) is free and deterministic: no model call, no reservation. It answers 202 like every edit, with the turn already APPLIED (example turnRemoveMedia), cause MEDIA, creates a revision without the media nodes (their slots become REMOVED and the hold on their assets ends) and does not count toward the 50 turns. It is the only action accepted in a CANCELLED session.

A rewrite never shows media to the model and never drops it: each media block of the target run stays in the document (same node, same slot, now attached to the new revision) right after the rewritten block that carries the node ID of the nearest text block before it in the run, in its original order; a media block that opened the run stays first, and one whose anchor did not survive the rewrite (gone or changed type) goes to the end of the range.

Every block outside the target is the same JSON in the new revision (same node IDs); a rewritten block whose type is unchanged keeps its node ID (MBM handle rule), its descendants and new blocks get new IDs.

The blocks to rewrite may weigh at most 2050 estimated tokens (the output bound of 4500 holds them again and a longer rewrite): a bigger target is 422 RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED with limit EDIT_TARGET_SIZE and limits.maxEditTargetTokens; the client splits the selection.

The edit is interactive: its step is offered to workers before drafts, is never parked by the daily burst, and fails its turn with DEADLINE_EXCEEDED (hold released) when no worker claimed it within learning.generation.edit.queue-timeout (PT2M).

EXERCISE artifacts (AI-16, decision 16): the exercise of a REVISE_EXERCISE session accepts FREE (instruction required, no target: the exercise is rewritten whole through the exercise pipeline, one EDIT turn, EDIT_SELECTION) and AUDIO_REGENERATE (voice required: one TTS turn, TTS_CLIP_30S held; AI-09 synthesises every audio block of the exercise in the new voice as new assets in a new exercise revision, cause MEDIA, debited per cache miss). The turn's targetNodeIds is []. The proposals of an EXERCISES session still refuse every edit with 409 GENERATION_STATE_CONFLICT / ILLEGAL_STATE (decision 15).
Every turn carries `voice` (female | male | null, set for an AUDIO_REGENERATE turn of an exercise).

IMAGE_SEARCH (AI-10, #296): target is exactly one IMAGE node of mode search (any slot state, FAILED included: it is also «Повторить»); instruction, optional, 1..200 code points, replaces the search query (else the slot's query). 202 with the turn QUEUED and the artifact REVISING; the worker runs one IMAGE_SEARCH step (PT3M): it searches the configured sources (Pixabay, Openverse, Wikimedia Commons; the Stub in local runs and CI), keeps only commercially usable licenses, drops results already among the slot's candidates, downloads up to 4 new ones through the safe fetcher and stages each as an untrusted upload (origin generated) through the media pipeline. When at least one becomes READY the turn is APPLIED with a new revision (cause MEDIA) whose image node uses the first READY new candidate (attribution on the slot), the artifact PROPOSED on it and the other new candidates listed in mediaSlots[].candidates (selectMediaCandidate switches among them, revert is «Вернуть»). Nothing usable: the turn FAILED with errorCode NO_RESULT, every source failing: PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE; the revision and the slot are unchanged and nothing is debited (example turnImageSearchApplied).

The initial IMAGE_SEARCH child step of a TEXT_DRAFT slot (mode search) runs the same search but stages only the best result, under the slot's pre-allocated assetId (no new revision): the slot goes PENDING → GENERATING → VERIFYING → READY with that one candidate (chosen), or FAILED (NO_RESULT, PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, VERIFICATION_REJECTED, DEADLINE_EXCEEDED). It is priced in the session's hold (IMAGE_SEARCH extra of the spec). A FAILED slot offers «Повторить» (IMAGE_SEARCH edit without instruction), «Заменить» (IMAGE_SEARCH edit with the user's query) and «Убрать блок» (REMOVE_MEDIA).

AUDIO_REGENERATE on a material (AI-09, #297): target exactly one AUDIO node; optional voice (absent: the slot's voice). 202 with the turn QUEUED and the artifact REVISING; one TTS step (PT2M) synthesises the node's transcript in the slot's lang through the speech cache: the same (normalized text, lang, voice, provider, model, model version, format, take) is a cache hit with no provider call and no debit. A redo in the SAME voice is a new take (the cache key's take grows), so it is a real synthesis and debited; a redo in another voice may hit the cache. The bytes (or the cached verified blob) become a new asset of the owner (origin generated) through the media pipeline; the turn is APPLIED with a new revision (cause MEDIA) whose audio node uses the new asset, the slot's voice and asset follow it. Failure: the turn FAILED (PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, VERIFICATION_REJECTED via the slot, DEADLINE_EXCEEDED, PERSONAL_DATA when the transcript holds an e-mail address, a telephone or a card number: it is never sent to a provider), the revision and the slot are unchanged, nothing debited.

The initial TTS child step of a TEXT_DRAFT audio slot (AI-09) synthesises through the same cache under the slot's pre-allocated assetId (no new revision): PENDING → GENERATING → VERIFYING → READY, or FAILED (PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, VERIFICATION_REJECTED, DEADLINE_EXCEEDED, PERSONAL_DATA when the text holds an e-mail address, a telephone or a card number: refused before any provider call, ESTIMATE_EXCEEDED when the session hold has no clip left). It is priced in the session hold (TTS_CLIP_30S per material and per exercise voice redo, as for image search) and debited only on a cache miss. A FAILED audio slot offers «Повторить» (AUDIO_REGENERATE without voice) and «Убрать блок» (REMOVE_MEDIA).

endpoints.summary: Move the current-revision pointer to another revision of the same artifact (undo and redo of edits). Creates and deletes nothing.

errors.when: Malformed or unknown field, duplicate JSON key, bad UUID or version.
Foreign or absent deck, session or artifact, or a revision that is not one of this artifact's: one opaque boundary.
Artifact changed.

Operation not allowed in the current session or artifact state: the session is not RUNNING or REVIEW, the artifact is not PROPOSED (a turn in flight makes it REVISING, which refuses a revert), it is an EXERCISE (until AI-16 #294), or the revision is from before the artifact was last retried.
commandId was used for a different command.

notes: toRevisionId must be one of the revisions listed by getArtifact (the current generation of the draft, at most 30 for rewrites): earlier or later than the current one; the current revision is a 200 no-op. A revision from before the artifact was last retried (a retry writes a new INITIAL revision from other pins) is history, readable with ?revisionId= but never restored: 409 ILLEGAL_STATE. No revision is created and none is deleted, so the history (revisions, turns) stays and a revert can be undone by another revert; an edit made after a revert is a new revision (a branch).
Evaluation order: 404, receipt replay, 400 body, 412 expectedArtifactVersion, 409 state, 404 unknown revision.

Media slots follow the shown revision: a slot whose node the revision holds is attached to it, one whose node it does not hold becomes REMOVED. Restoring a revision whose media node had its slot REMOVED shows the node without a ready asset (the hold ended): the slot is FAILED with errorCode NO_RESULT (a MEDIA_SLOT_STATE event), so approval answers 409 MEDIA_NOT_READY until REMOVE_MEDIA removes the node again.
Events: ARTIFACT_STATE (PROPOSED, new artifactVersion and currentRevisionId) and MEDIA_SLOT_STATE for each slot that changed state.
The exercise of a REVISE_EXERCISE session can be reverted to any revision of its draft (its audio slots follow the revision shown); the proposals of an EXERCISES session cannot (409 ILLEGAL_STATE).

endpoints.summary: Use another found image (AI-10, #296): the image node of the slot points at the chosen READY candidate's asset in a new revision (cause MEDIA). Free (no model call, no reservation) and synchronous; «Вернуть» is the ordinary revert to the previous revision.

fields.expectedRevisionId: the artifact's current revision as the client shows it (stale is 412 VERSION_CONFLICT)
fields.candidateId: a READY candidate of this slot (candidates[] of getArtifact)

body.note: the getArtifact body of the new current revision

expectedRevisionId is not the current revision.

The session is not RUNNING or REVIEW, the artifact is not PROPOSED (an edit is running: EDIT_IN_PROGRESS first), the slot is not an IMAGE slot of mode search in the current revision, or the candidate is not READY.
A turn of this artifact is QUEUED or RUNNING.
commandId was used for a different command.

notes: Choosing the candidate that is already chosen is a no-op 200 (no revision).

The new revision equals the current one except the image node's assetId, which becomes the candidate's (alt and caption are kept). The slot keeps its slotKey and is attached to the new revision; its attribution becomes the candidate's; the generation_media_ref holds of all candidates of the slot last until the session ends.
Not a turn: it is listed in revisions (cause MEDIA), not in turns, and does not count toward the 50 turns.

endpoints.summary: Retry a FAILED artifact (not for errorCode REFUSAL) or regenerate a STALE one against the new source revision: back to QUEUED, a new reservation is made.

errors.when: Malformed or unknown field, duplicate JSON key, bad UUID or version.
Foreign or absent deck, session or artifact: one opaque boundary.
Artifact changed.
State is not FAILED or STALE, the session does not allow it, or the errorCode is REFUSAL.
The reservation or debit does not fit a credit, cap, fair-use or daily-burst limit.
A capability the operation needs is off.
A pinned owned note or material exists but no longer matches the pin, or has been deleted since.
commandId was used for a different command.
Retrying turns a REVIEW session that does not count as active into a counted one and the account already has the maximum of active sessions.

notes: Cancels any QUEUED or RUNNING turn of the artifact.

A new STEP reservation of the artifact's weight is made first (409 USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED leaves nothing changed); the debit of the new run draws from it and it ends with the session's return to REVIEW. A STALE artifact is regenerated against the pins as they are now (the artifact's sourceRefs are replaced); a FAILED one needs its pins to hold (SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE otherwise). The slots and holds of the replaced revision are dropped.

A REVIEW session that holds only FAILED or REJECTED leftovers does not count as active; retrying makes it count again, so the 3-active-sessions limit is checked first (422 RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, limit ACTIVE_SESSIONS, before usage).
An EXERCISE artifact is written again as ONE exercise (one TEXT_DRAFT step with count 1, a STEP reservation of one exercise's credits); a STALE one is regenerated against the pins as they are now.

A REVISE_ITEM or REVISE_EXERCISE artifact is not retried (409 GENERATION_STATE_CONFLICT, reason NOT_RETRYABLE): it is a copy of what existed, a stale one is replaced by a new session and «Ещё раз» is a new edit.

generationSpec.description: Immutable after create. The server clamps values and echoes the stored spec back so the client can show it as chips. Unknown fields are INVALID_REQUEST. REVISE_ITEM and REVISE_EXERCISE are final since AI-16 (#294).

common.outputLanguage: BCP 47 per the native-v1 lexical profile; default is the deck language, else the UI language

MATERIALS.prompt: 0..2000 characters; required when there is no SOURCE source. Limit chosen equal to the turn instruction limit (architecture section 3); revisit in AI-04.
MATERIALS.sources: 0..20 pinned sources: {role: SOURCE|STYLE_EXAMPLE, type: NOTE, noteId, noteRowVersion[, overrides]} or {role, type: ITEM, memberKey, itemRevisionId}. At most 2 STYLE_EXAMPLE, items only. The pins are immutable for the session. A noteId, or a memberKey with the same itemRevisionId, may appear once: a repeat is 400 INVALID_REQUEST (artifacts and overrides are positional). A NOTE + SOURCE entry may carry sparse per-note `overrides` (decision 13): {effort?, media?: {audio?: {enabled, lang?, voice?}, imageSearch?}}; every member optional, the object and its media member non-empty (`{}` is INVALID_REQUEST, send none); an absent member keeps the session value; an `audio` override replaces the whole clip setting. Allowed only with notesMode ONE_PER_NOTE (and at least one NOTE source); on any other entry, with MERGE_INTO_ONE, or malformed: 400 INVALID_REQUEST. Echoed unchanged in the stored spec. The estimate and the admission hold price each material with its effective settings, capability checks (audio -> textToSpeech, imageSearch) apply to the effective values, and the TEXT_DRAFT context of the note's material carries the effective effort and media directives of that note only.

settings.notesMode: ONE_PER_NOTE (default) | MERGE_INTO_ONE; ignored without NOTE sources
settings.media: {audio: {enabled, lang, voice: female|male|null}, imageSearch: boolean}; per-note overrides: see sources
settings.factCheck: boolean: web research by effort (architecture section 14)
settings.similarToDeck: boolean: add deck exemplars to the brief ('Похоже на: как в колоде')
settings.planFirst: boolean: «Сначала показать план» (AI-14, #295, decision 17): the session starts PLANNING with no artifact; a PLAN step proposes the plan, the owner edits and launches it (planApproval). Adds the separate estimate line SMART_PLAN_FLASH and uses one smart plan of the cap. 422 SPEC_NOT_SUPPORTED (kind MATERIALS) only when the planner is disabled (learning.generation.planner.enabled=false).
settings.budgetPercent: null or 1..100: spend at most this share of the current remaining budget on the session

MATERIALS.artifacts: ONE_PER_NOTE creates one artifact per NOTE source; MERGE_INTO_ONE or prompt-only creates one. More than 20 is RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
MATERIALS.media: Declared media counts bound the compiler (MBM maxMedia, at most 8 per artifact) and the estimate prices only those.

EXERCISES.targets: 1..20 materials {memberKey, itemRevisionId}: multi-select or one material profile. A deck-wide selection beyond 20 materials is split by the client into several sessions (uncovered materials first). Limit: owner decision 2026-10-02, key learning.generation.max-exercise-targets.

settings.mechanics: AUTO or a nonempty set of SELF_CHECK, FREE_RESPONSE, CLOZE, CHOICE, MATCH, ORDER, CATEGORIZE (server registry)
settings.priority: UNCOVERED_FIRST (default): the targets with the fewest enabled exercises are processed first | BALANCED: the order of the request. With BUDGET_PERCENT the resolved total is spread over the targets in that order, so a short budget serves the first ones.
settings.quantity: {mode: AUTO} | {mode: EXACT, perTarget: 1..10} | {mode: BUDGET_PERCENT, percent: 1..100}; mutually exclusive by mode. The resolved total is at most 60 exercises per session (owner decision 2026-10-02). There is NO silent clamp: above the limits the answer is 422 RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED with limit and the limits, and the client offers to split into several sessions.
settings.planFirst: boolean: «Сначала показать план» (AI-14, #295, decision 17); the same as for MATERIALS. 422 SPEC_NOT_SUPPORTED (kind EXERCISES) only when the planner is disabled.
settings.budgetPercent: null or 1..100 (same meaning as for MATERIALS)

REVISE_ITEM.target: the material and the revision the owner saw, which must still be the head (409 SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE); an unknown or foreign material or an unknown revision is the opaque 404
REVISE_ITEM.notes: Exact fields (unknown is INVALID_REQUEST). No budget, no effort: a revision is one EDIT_SELECTION turn over the whole material. The client builds it from the intent (createIntent) or by hand.

REVISE_EXERCISE.shape: {kind: REVISE_EXERCISE, target: {exerciseId, exerciseRevisionId}, instruction?, media?: {action: AUDIO_REGENERATE, voice: female|male}, outputLanguage?}
REVISE_EXERCISE.target: the exercise and the revision the owner saw, which must still be its head
REVISE_EXERCISE.instruction: 0..2000 code points; blank or absent only with media (at least one of the two)
REVISE_EXERCISE.media: redo the audio of the exercise: an edit of the exercise's audio slots with a voice. Delivered as the model, the turn, the slot and a Stub executor (AI-16, owner decision 2026-10-03): the audio does not change and the slot records the voice; real synthesis and its acceptance are AI-09 (#297).

sessionDetail.approvableCount: Number of artifacts that can be approved now: PROPOSED with every media slot READY or REMOVED (not STALE, not REVISING). The pager summary ('7 ready') and the GENERATION_READY notification use it; the client derives 'writing' from QUEUED + GENERATING and 'failed' from FAILED.
sessionDetail.usage: {reservedCredits, spentCredits}: the session's initial-batch reservation (ACTIVE holds only), see contracts/usage
sessionDetail.notes: {used, archivable}: used = distinct NOTE sources (role SOURCE) referenced by at least one PUBLISHED or HANDED_OFF artifact and by no artifact still in play (QUEUED, GENERATING, PROPOSED, REVISING, STALE, retryable FAILED); archivable = used notes that are not archived and whose row_version still equals the pinned one. The UI shows 'Archive the used notes (k)' when k > 0 (operation archiveUsedNotes). Detail only, not in summaries.
sessionDetail.plan: null for a session without a plan; for a plan-first session (decision 17) the plan: null while PLANNING, the model's plan from PLAN_READY on (approved false), and the owner's approved plan once launched (approved true). Detail only, not in summaries. Shape: schemas.plan.

artifactSummary.title: Preview title of the current revision (first heading or paragraph, at most 240 code points) for the pager
artifactSummary.mediaSlotCounts: {total, ready, failed} counts of slots of the current revision; the slots themselves are in getArtifact mediaSlots
artifactSummary.repinStatus: null | AUTO_REPINNED | NEEDS_USER_DECISION. NEEDS_USER_DECISION comes with STALE. AUTO_REPINNED (exercises only) comes with PROPOSED: the server moved the pins of a proposed exercise to the current head of its material without a model (a REPIN revision); it is cleared when the artifact is published or retried.
artifactSummary.publishedRef: null until PUBLISHED: {kind: ITEM, memberKey, itemRevisionId, ordinal} or {kind: EXERCISE, exerciseId, exerciseRevisionId, objectiveId, objectiveRevisionId}
artifactSummary.errorCode: null or an artifact error code (states.json artifact.errorCodes)

turn.status: QUEUED | RUNNING | APPLIED | FAILED | CANCELLED (states.json turn.states)
turn.action: REWRITE | IMAGE_SEARCH | IMAGE_GENERATE | AUDIO_REGENERATE | FREE | REMOVE_MEDIA
turn.preset: null, or SIMPLER | SHORTER | EXAMPLE | LONGER (REWRITE only)
turn.instruction: echoed text; a speech transcript is stored as text, the audio is never kept; null for REMOVE_MEDIA
turn.targetNodeIds: the block node IDs the edit addressed, in document order
turn.resultRevisionId: null until APPLIED: the revision the turn made
turn.errorCode: null, or when FAILED: an artifact error code (INVALID_OUTPUT, REFUSAL, SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, ESTIMATE_EXCEEDED, DEADLINE_EXCEEDED); an IMAGE_SEARCH turn fails with NO_RESULT, PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE or DEADLINE_EXCEEDED (states.json turn.imageSearchErrorCodes); an AUDIO_REGENERATE turn fails with PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, VERIFICATION_REJECTED, DEADLINE_EXCEEDED, ESTIMATE_EXCEEDED or PERSONAL_DATA (states.json turn.audioErrorCodes)
turn.voice: null, or female | male for an AUDIO_REGENERATE turn (the requested voice; for a material without a voice in the request: the slot's voice at admission)

mediaSlotExercise.description: mediaSlots of a REVISE_EXERCISE artifact (an exercise has no nodes): one slot per AUDIO block of the exercise.
mediaSlotExercise.slotKey: audio1, audio2, ... in order of the blocks
mediaSlotExercise.nodeId: an id of the slot itself (there is no node in the exercise)
mediaSlotExercise.assetId: the asset the audio block uses; a redo (AUDIO_REGENERATE with a voice) synthesises a new asset (AI-09, #297) and the exercise revision of the turn uses it
mediaSlotExercise.state: READY (a redo ends READY; a slot is never PENDING for an exercise)
mediaSlotExercise.voice: female | male | null: the voice of the last redo, null before one ran

plan.description: The plan of a plan-first session (getSession.plan). The identifiers are the owner's own: the memberKey of a target material, the noteId of a source note. The model's handles (m1, n2) never leave the server.
plan.approved: false while the owner may still edit (PLAN_READY), true once launched; after that it is what was launched
plan.items: EXERCISES: [{memberKey, title, mechanics: [..], count: 1..10, why}]; MATERIALS: [{source: noteId|null, title: 1..160, effort: SHORT|MEDIUM|DETAILED, why, creditsByEffort: {SHORT, MEDIUM, DETAILED}}]. In the order the work is done; why is the model's reason (at most 200 characters, empty for an item the owner added).
plan.targets: EXERCISES: [{memberKey, title, exercises}] every material of the spec with the number of exercises it has (the rows the owner may drop or take back)
plan.sources: MATERIALS: [{noteId, label}] every note of the spec with the first line of its pinned text (at most 60 characters)
plan.totals: {items, artifacts}: the rows and the artifacts the plan creates (one per exercise, one per material)
plan.cost: {planCredits: what the plan itself cost (debited apart), batchCredits: what the artifacts of the plan cost, holdCredits: what the batch hold covers, barCredits: the credit bar of the period (the percentages are a share of it), holdActive: boolean, computed when the session is read and not stored: whether the batch hold is still live}. At PLAN_READY batchCredits <= holdCredits; after the owner's edits the approval re-sizes the hold to batchCredits. The hold of a PLAN_READY session is not renewed and lapses after learning.usage.reservation-ttl (PT2H) without changing the session's rowVersion: holdActive false tells the client that launching reserves again and may be refused 409 USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED.
plan.rates: EXERCISES: {exercisesPerFive: 8}, so the client prices an edit as ceil(8 x n / 5); MATERIALS: {note}, the price of an item is creditsByEffort of its own
plan.allowedMechanics: EXERCISES only: the mechanics the spec allows, in registry order
plan.notes: [{code, text}] what the server did to the model's plan: TRIMMED_TO_BUDGET (items taken off the end because the plan cost more than the hold)

mediaSlotItem.description: mediaSlots of an ITEM artifact (getArtifact): one per media node of the shown revision. AI-10 (#296) adds attribution and candidates for IMAGE slots of mode search; every other slot has attribution null and candidates [].
mediaSlotItem.slotKey: the MBM slot key (stable across revisions)
mediaSlotItem.mode: IMAGE: search | generate (the directive's mode); null for AUDIO and VIDEO. Only a search slot offers «Найти похожее», candidates and selectMediaCandidate
mediaSlotItem.voice: AUDIO: female | male (the slot's voice: the directive's, or the last redo's); null for IMAGE and VIDEO
mediaSlotItem.lang: AUDIO: the BCP 47 tag of the spoken text; null otherwise
mediaSlotItem.nodeId: the media node of the shown revision
mediaSlotItem.assetId: the asset the node uses now (for an image search slot: the chosen candidate's asset once one is chosen)
mediaSlotItem.state: PENDING | GENERATING | VERIFYING | READY | FAILED | REMOVED (states.json mediaSlot)
mediaSlotItem.attribution: null, or the chosen candidate's attribution {source, title, author, license, licenseUrl, sourcePageUrl, shareAlike}. Revisions in the Workshop do not carry it: approve (GeneratedItemPublisher) and handoff («Править самому») write it into the published/handed-off image node's caption as «Автор · Источник · Лицензия» (appended after an existing caption with « — »), so the published material always attributes the image.
mediaSlotItem.candidates: 0..12 image candidates the searches of this slot found and staged, in the order they were found: {candidateId, assetId, state (VERIFYING | READY | FAILED), source (PIXABAY | OPENVERSE | WIKIMEDIA | STUB), title (≤300, may be empty), author (≤200, may be empty), license (short name, e.g. «Pixabay Content License», «CC BY-SA 4.0», «CC0 1.0», «Public domain»), licenseUrl (https or null), sourcePageUrl (https page of the image at the source), shareAlike (true for BY-SA: the client marks it), width, height, chosen (true for exactly the candidate the shown revision uses, else false)}. A candidate's asset is the owner's own media asset (rendered like any asset, never a hotlink).

research.requests: integer ≥0: paid requests made by the RESEARCH step (the debit is WEB_SEARCH_QUERY × requests)
research.results: 0..30 {n (1-based, server order: query order then rank), url (https), title (≤300), provider}
